correctness.rationale: Conventions fixed and verified: n=7, N=128, LSB=x0, rho(v)=((v>>1)|((v&1)<<6))&0x7F, dot parity(a&x), W(a)=sum_x(-1)^{f(x)+a.x}, nl=64-max|W|/2. Independent recomputation confirms G=20 with minima [0,1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15,19,21,23,27,29,31,43,47,55,63,127], sizes 1,1,7x18, formula (128+12)/7=20, weight preservation, and row-mask list with rank 20. Full histogram independently reproduced via batched NumPy FWHT over all 2^20 masks (B=4096, different code path from C): exact match on all 33 values summing to 1048576, max 56. All 33 lex-min ANF representatives independently reproduced via batched Mobius+FWHT (B=8192): truth/ANF masks match best_per_nl.csv for every nl. All 33 reps rechecked with pure-Python FWHT/Mobius: nl, ANF mask, degree, weight, W0=N-2wt, |W| multiset, Parseval 16384 all match representatives_full.csv. Extremal spectra match published files bit-for-bit (128 ints): nl56 mask 194304/0x2f700 ANF 46848/0x0b700 deg4 wt56 W0=16 |W|={0:64,16:64} signed {-16:28,0:64,+16:36} autocorr max16; nl55 mask 718592/0xaf700 ANF 571136/0x8b700 deg7 wt57 W0=14 |W|={2:64,14:36,18:28} autocorr max20; FWHT(W^2)/N divisibility exact and equals naive autocorrelation. Lex-minimality among extremal sets verified (distinct ANFs 11788/22344, unique minimum). Degree/weight distributions rechecked: nl56 2:28,3:560,4:5880,5:4704,6:616 and 56:2793,58:154,64:5894,70:154,72:2793; nl55 all deg7 and 57/63/65/71 each 5586. Bulk clusters collapse verified: 33 fine clusters collapse to exactly 11 distinct (deg,|W|,acmax) for nl56 and 48 to exactly 12 for nl55 after collapsing non-invariant W0, as claimed (>=11/>=12). Invariant theory correct: degree preserved for deg>=2 under x->Ax+b plus affine addition, |W| multiset permuted, |r| magnitudes permuted (r_g(s)=+/-r_f(As)); W0 explicitly not used. Bounded 4x100k search correctly labeled non-probative (group ~5e18). Hex packing verified for extremals. SHA-256 of all 29 artifact files verified OK. Draft honestly separates computed theorem (a-c via enumeration) from invariant lower bounds (d) and disclaims exact class count and priority.

originality.rationale: Compared exact hypotheses, quantifiers, parameter ranges, constants and proof scope. Candidate is a computed theorem: exhaustive Walsh-Hadamard census over all 2^20 n=7 RSBFs yielding a specific 33-value histogram summing to 1048576, RSBF-restricted covering radius max nl=56 (11788 maximizers with max|W|=16, 22344 next-maximizers with max|W|=18), plus lex-min canonical representatives (e.g. nl=56 truth 194304/0x2f700 ANF 46848/0x0b700 deg 4 wt 56 |W|={0:64,16:64}; nl=55 truth 718592 ANF 571136 deg 7) and >=11/>=12 affine-class lower bounds. Cusick-Stanica (2000) covers only degree-2 exact formulas and degree-3 conjectures. Stanica-Maitra (2008) gives the G=20 orbit-count formula and general bounds/examples, not the distribution. Kavut-Yucel (2008) is n=9 heuristic search (241/242), not n=7 exhaustive. Zhang et al (2010) and Yang et al (2012) are single-family parametric theorems (degree-3 and quartic monomial), not a census. Mykkeltveit (1980) gives only the unrestricted RM(1,7) radius 56, not the RSBF-restricted equality via enumeration. Crossref/Semantic Scholar queries for 'nonlinearity distribution', 'exhaustive enumeration seven variables', and 'covering radius n=7 56' returned only construction/bound/heuristic papers, no 33-value table, no 11788/22344 counts, no lex-min hex/spectra. No retrieved source substantively covers or implies the candidate table.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding later as compact checkable reference, not textbook/parameter-substitution/tiny-gain/bare-enumeration: (i) RSBF-restricted covering radius of RM(1,7) equals unrestricted 56, with 11788 explicit maximizers including plateaued/semi-bent type |W|={0:64,16:64} of degree 4 weight 56 — a concrete coding/crypto fact (nonlinearity governs linear-cryptanalysis resistance) directly reusable for design; (ii) full 33-value distribution with per-value canonical ANF representatives, degrees, spectra, hex and orbit-sum expressions provides a lookup table no textbook gives; (iii) structural analysis beyond bare counts: degree distributions, 4 Walsh types and 5 acmax values in maximizers, 4xN types in next-max, 11/12 affine-class lower bounds via genuine invariants, weight symmetries, and gap pattern (steps of 7 below 44) prompting divisibility conjecture (explicitly unclaimed). Heuristic prior examples are subsumed and certified. Reproducible in seconds with published generator plus independent NumPy path.
